notes.title: ELITE UPDATE : UPDATE : V0.1.9
notes.content:
[h3][b]ELITE MOBS ADDED[/b][/h3]
[b]+Mobs will now randomly have the Elite Tag changing their behaviour and/or stats[/b]
+Gold Elite added: rewards extra credits
+Fire Elite added: increased fire damage

[h3][b]NEW GUN UPGRADE[/b][/h3]
[b]+Shark Fang added: increases critical chance[/b]

[h3][b]DAMAGE OVER TIME CRIT[/b][/h3]
[b]+All Damage over Time can now randomly crit enemies[/b]

[b][i]+Other minor changes and improvements[/i][/b]

notes.title: GUNPUNK : UPDATE : V0.1.7
notes.content:
[h3][b]BURNING AND FREEZING[/b][/h3]
[b]+Magma Worm Upgrade now Burns[/b]
[b]+Frost Flower Upgrade now Chills and Freezes[/b]
Mobs can be set on fire to do Damage Over Time. They can also be Chilled: reducing their movement speed. If they are chilled enough, they will Freeze and shatter on next hit

[h3][b]NEW ROOM, NEW ZOMBIE[/b][/h3]
[b]+Combat Room 10 Added[/b]
[b]+Crawling Zombie Added[/b]

[h3][b]SMALL CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[b]+Status DoT Hitmarkers added[/b]
[b]+Shotgun Damage Improved[/b]
[b]+Difficulty Scaling Improved[/b]
Mobs difficulty reduced in the first few rooms. Difficulty increases more the further you travel

[b][i]+Other minor changes and improvements[/i][/b]

notes.title: GUNPUNK : UPDATE : V0.1.6
notes.content:
[h3][b]DIFFICULTY[/b][/h3]
[b]+Added Linear Difficulty System[/b]
Mobs now have tiers that increase their stats. They will gradually grow higher and higher in tier as the player progresses further and further into the dungeon.

[h3][b]LEVEL DESIGN[/b][/h3]
[b]+New Philosophy[/b]
We are combining the Modular System with a new Testing System. Each level will be constructed in an Act structure. This will allow us to test the level design with greater vigour

[b][i]+Other minor changes and improvements[/i][/b]

notes.title: GUNPUNK : UPDATE : V0.1.5
notes.content:
[h3][b]DYNAMIC MUSIC SYSTEM[/b][/h3]
[b]+Added Simple Music Loops[/b]
[b]+Music changes according to Player's State[/b]
Music will change if Player is in combat or not

[h3][b]PLAYER SHIELD UPDATE[/b][/h3]
[b]+Shield now only recharges at end of room[/b]

[h3][b]HUGE BACKEND FIXED[/b][/h3]
[b]+All Mob Modules have been refactored and improved[/b]
This makes it easier for us to develop more mobs and mob variations in the future

[b][i]+Other minor changes and improvements[/i][/b]

notes.title: GUNPUNK : UPDATE : V0.1.4
notes.content:
[h3][b]PLAYER SHIELD ADDED[/b][/h3]
[b]+Recharging Shield added to the player stats[/b]
Allows the Player to take some damage before health is reduced

[h3][b]NEW ROOM ADDED[/b][/h3]
[b]+Large Branch Room added[/b]
+More Objects: Shelves, Barrels, Slabs
Now testing larger rooms with more enemies

[h3][b]MONSTERS IMPROVED[/b][/h3]
[b]+"Infested Slave", "Drone", & "Turret" Improved[/b]
+Monsters can now scale in size
+Vision Cones improved
+Hearing module improved

[h3][b]MINOR CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[b]+More Decals added[/b]
[b]+Gun Light improvements[/b]

[b][i]+Other minor changes and improvements[/i][/b]

notes.title: GUNPUNK : UPDATE : V0.1.3
notes.content:
[h3][b]SHOP ROOM: IMPROVED[/b][/h3]
[b]+Shop Room with three shop points added[/b]
Player can now purchase upgrades at shop with credits earned in the dungeon

[h3][b]INPUT OVERHAUL[/b][/h3]
[b]+Controller Inputs updated[/b]
Index Inputs have been improved to allow: reloading, toggling light, sprinting, changing firemode with A and B buttons

[h3][b]INFESTED SLAVE: IMPROVED[/b][/h3]
[b]+Hearing Module has been improved for responsiveness[/b]
[b]+Added Eyeball for Sight[/b]
[b]+Added Stumble Mechanic[/b]
Player can now hit the Infested Slave with their gun to make them stumble; stunning them for a moment

[h3][b]MINOR CHANGES[/b][/h3]
[b]+Shadows Improved[/b]
[b]+Damage Response Audio[/b]
Audio plays when Player takes damage

[b][i]+Other minor changes and improvements[/i][/b]

notes.title: GUNPUNK : UPDATE : V0.1.2
notes.content:
[h3][b]MODULAR ROOMS ADDED[/b][/h3]
[b]+3 New Rooms added[/b]
The modular system is being improved with each room created, and is allowing us to create rooms much faster than before

[h3][b]SOUND HITS ADDED[/b][/h3]
[b]+New Random Sounds that play during the run[/b]

[h3][b]INFESTED SLAVE: IMPROVED[/b][/h3]
[b]+"Infested Slave" new attack[/b]
[b]+Improved Animations and Ragdoll[/b]
[b]+Headshots now pop the Infested Slaves' head[/b]

[b][i]+Minor changes and improvements[/i][/b]

notes.title: GUNPUNK : UPDATE : V0.1.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]+ROOM DESIGN REVIEW[/b][/h3]
[b]+New Room added[/b]
We have begun to use modular parts to create rooms, improving our workflow significantly. And more importantly: giving you more rooms to fight through

[h3][b]+NEW MONSTER: INFESTED SLAVE[/b][/h3]
[b]+The "Infested Slave" has been added[/b]
We want a slow moving, but dangerous monster...

[b][i]+Minor changes and improvements[/i][/b]

notes.title: GUNPUNK : UPDATE : V0.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]+NEW START MENU[/b][/h3]
[b]New Starting Menu to adjust:[/b]
[list]
[*]Play Mode: Standing/Sitting
[*]Turn Mode: Smooth/Snap
[*]Master Volume
[/list]
[h3][b]+LEVEL TRANSPORTATION[/b][/h3]
[b]New Shuttle to transport players to the dungeon[/b]

[h3][b]+DEATH[/b][/h3]
[b]Player will now return to the HUB on death and be able to try again[/b]


[h3][b]<MINOR CHANGES>[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Audio Mixer improved
[*]Bullet Shell Collisions improved
[*]New Dirt Shader added
[/list]
